requirements.text: Freeze the Phase 39.5 parent archive and checksum inheritance evidence.
Publish the authoritative Phase 40 requirements and incremental milestone sequence.
Map Phase 40 requirements to implementation, schemas, tests, deployment and gates.
Declare all inherited Phase 15-39.5 gates without converting live gates into static passes.
Declare current OWL Direct capability status and keep unqualified standards claims disabled.
Register inherited HPC ceilings separately from planned Phase 40 Direct-reasoner ceilings.
Provide a cumulative Phase 15-40 static qualification entry point.
Require every runtime REST operation to appear in OpenAPI and vendored Swagger UI.
